summary: Luda Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 15, 2026, announcing its 2025 full year results via a press release. The filing also discloses 22,690,000 ordinary shares outstanding and contains forward-looking statements regarding a reverse split and trade halt removal. There are no special situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes; this is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer.
